# `aitbc coin-requests reopen`

Clear a request's transaction hash so it can be executed again.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc coin-requests reopen [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--request-id` | text | — | yes | The Request id. |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC to check against (defaults to BLOCKCHAIN_RPC_URL) |
| `--force` | flag | `false` | no | Reopen even though the chain still has the transaction |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Island to query; omit to let the node answer for its own chain |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc coin-requests reopen --request-id <request_id>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc coin-requests reopen --request-id <request_id> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
